statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-59711 is cross-site scripting in showdown metadata title handling when completeHTMLDocument is enabled (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cr32-g25g-vxjj). No patched release is listed. Dependency-Track Frontend bundles showdown 2.1.0, so the code is present. Waiting for an upstream release that includes a fix.

CVE-2026-59710 is stored cross-site scripting in showdown's table-header id handling (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-22g5-r2x5-97cx). Versions through 2.1.0 are affected, and the cited fix is on the 3.0.0-rc2 pre-release line. Dependency-Track Frontend bundles showdown 2.1.0. Adopting showdown 3 is a major upgrade pending upstream.

No fixed showdown release exists for CVE-2024-1899, a regular-expression denial of service in the anchors subparser (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-1899). Dependency-Track Frontend bundles showdown 2.1.0, so the vulnerable code is present. Waiting for an upstream release that includes a fix.
